name: OpenCode
nameMangling: sanitize(server) + _ + sanitize(tool), where sanitize turns [^a-zA-Z0-9_-] into _; no prefix and no length cap (V, mcp/catalog.ts#L117-L119 at v1.19.4)
listChanged: handled, re-lists and publishes ToolsChanged (V, mcp/index.ts#L462)
sources: github.com/sst/opencode at v1.19.4: packages/core/src/global.ts, packages/opencode/src/config/config.ts, config/paths.ts, config/parse.ts, config/variable.ts, config/managed.ts, cli/cmd/mcp.ts, mcp/catalog.ts, packages/core/src/v1/config/mcp.ts (lane C research, batch 1, 27 Oct 2026)
notes: Files in ~/.config/opencode (XDG_CONFIG_HOME) merge config.json, then opencode.json, then opencode.jsonc; `opencode mcp add` writes opencode.json by default, and the loader seeds opencode.jsonc with only $schema on first run (V, config/config.ts#L141-L148, #L259-L276; cli/cmd/mcp.ts#L394-L410). tk writes opencode.json too. JSONC with trailing commas (jsonc-parser). Entry: local {type, command as one argv array, cwd, environment, enabled, timeout ms} or remote {type, url, headers, oauth, enabled, timeout}; no SSE value (V, packages/core/src/v1/config/mcp.ts#L6-L62). {env:VAR} and {file:path} are substituted in the raw file text before parsing, and a missing variable becomes empty (V, config/variable.ts#L33-L38), so tk refuses both forms in entry values. `opencode mcp add` edits with jsonc-parser modify, keeps comments and appends no newline (V). The macOS plist domain ai.opencode.managed is managed too.
